clues: This place is a city in Peru. It serves as the capital of its department there.
From February to August, the air is cold and dry. A rainy season fills the rest of the year.
This city got its start on August 5, 1572. It was set up by Francisco de Toledo, viceroy of Peru.
This place has a hard claim to fame. It is counted among the poorest cities in all of Peru.
Look for a city where Indigenous people are the majority. They make up the biggest share of the people who live there.
